Interface ProjectRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Project,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Project,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Project,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Project,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Project,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Project>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Project,UUID>
@Repository public interface ProjectRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Project,UUID>
Spring Data JPA repository for Project (project table). Owned by the workspace module.
